class ToolCall(BaseModel):
    def __init__(self, name: str, args: dict[str, Any]):
        self.name = name
        self.args = args
    
    def canonicalize(self) -> str:
        # Canonicalize the args
        args_sorted = {k: v for k, v in sorted(self.args.items())}
        args_list = [f'{k}: {v}' for k, v in args_sorted.items()]
        args_str = ', '.join(args_list)
        return f'{self.name}({args_str})'
    
    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
        import hashlib
        canonical_str = self.canonicalize()
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical_str.encode()).hexdigest()[:64]
    
    def id(self) -> str:
        return self.fingerprint()[:8]
